skill.summary: Zero-config text-to-speech — give text, get an mp3 file. Handles natural-language voice selection ("用女声", "撒娇语气", "生气一点") and auto-inserts pacing breaks for...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of quick-tts skill for fast, zero-config text-to-speech conversion.
- Supports natural-language voice selection, including moods and specific voice types (e.g. "温柔御姐", "生气一点").
- Automatically inserts pacing breaks for longer texts to enhance natural speech rhythm.
- Simple API integration: just provide text, receive an mp3 file—no technical setup required.
- Error handling for common API responses, including invalid key, long text, and rate limiting.
